text:
- [LTES.12.6] **Introspection primitives enumerated.** Activations,
  emissions, calls, cache ops, record-events, logs, logical
  lifecycle, timers, type-mismatch increments, cross-tier
  flow, compile diagnostics. Runtime must expose all; may
  expose more.
gap_reason: A summary list of the introspection a runtime exposes. Each primitive is tied where it is stated (NDBG, NCBK.2.3); the list adds no obligation of its own.
